tables.node: 22 (mise.toml's node); the patch version was not recorded
tables.runs: 5 pairs per page count, 1,930 pages first; each pair runs before and after on fresh pages, before first in even pairs (0, 2, 4) and after first in odd ones

metrics.zoom in fps: Frames per second over a zoom-in gesture (20 Ctrl-wheel notches of 8 px, 16 ms apart, over the page at 70 %), every frame from the first notch to 300 ms after the last; null when the gesture's median frame is 25 ms or more (paced at 30 Hz)
metrics.zoom in longest frame ms: The longest frame interval of that zoom-in gesture
metrics.zoom out fps: As zoom in fps, for the zoom-out gesture that follows it
metrics.zoom out longest frame ms: The longest frame interval of that zoom-out gesture
metrics.open ms: Click reference.pdf in the navigator to the first animation frame with its page 1 drawn (a canvas not hidden)
metrics.jump ms: Enter in the compiled preview's page field, 70 % of the page count typed, to the first frame with that page drawn
metrics.scroll fps: Frames per second scrolling 120 px a frame for 200 frames; null when paced at 30 Hz as above
metrics.scroll frames with a blank page: Scroll frames with a page on screen not drawn yet
metrics.elements: document.getElementsByTagName('*').length once the second PDF is open

tables.aggregation: Median across a variant's runs at one page count (scripts/check-perf-evidence.mjs's median, which is the driver's). Runs whose figure is null (WebKit fps of a measurement paced at 30 Hz) are left out; none in these runs. Cells round half away from zero to the row's digits.
